title: Hiking Across a Volcanic Landscape
hook: What if you hike across an active volcano?

beats.line: Your skin burns as hot volcanic ground radiates searing heat.
beats.idea: Close-up of the character’s foot on hot black rock, steam rising, skin reddening.

beats.line: Your eyes water, throat burns from choking sulfur fumes.
beats.idea: Character covering eyes, coughing, a greenish gas swirling around.

beats.line: Your lungs fill with fine ash, each breath feels gritty.
beats.idea: Side view of character inhaling, ash particles visible inside a cartoon lung outline.

beats.line: Your heart races, pumping faster to cool your overheated body.
beats.idea: Heart icon beating faster, sweat droplets, temperature gauge rising.

beats.line: Your blood thickens from dehydration, leaving you dizzy and light‑headed.
beats.idea: Close-up of blood vessels narrowing, character swaying, dizzy stars around head.

description: A quick trek across a volcanic landscape shows how heat, gases, ash, and dehydration affect your body.

end.line: Will you hike it, yes or no?

topic: What happens if you hike across a volcanic landscape?
